name: Dates & Wires
source:
The year is 1995, and you're newly single, ready to mingle... and fresh off the plane in Stradania, the dysfunctional micronation whose chief exports are pig iron, human misery, and radioactive souvenir mugs. 

Your travel guides have steered you to the hottest nightclub in town. Now it's up to you to seize the evening by getting up close and intimate with Stradania's Least Eligible Bachelors. Except all of these guys have their own thing going on and finding a date is the least of their problems...

[From [url=https://ioblack.itch.io/dates-and-wires]itch.io[/url]]

A visual novel spinoff of the webcomic [url=https://www.drugsandwires.fail/]Drugs & Wires[/url].
translation:
1995年，你刚刚单身，准备好交往……刚从斯特拉达尼亚的飞机上下来，这是一个功能失调的微型国家，其主要出口产品是生铁、人类苦难和放射性纪念品杯。

你的旅行指南已带你前往镇上最热门的夜总会。现在，你要抓住这个夜晚，与斯特拉达尼亚的最不合格单身汉进行近距离接触。除了所有这些人都有自己的事情要做之外，找到约会对象是他们最不重要的问题……

[来自[url=https://ioblack.itch.io/dates-and-wires]itch.io[/url]]

网络漫画 [url=https://www.drugsandwires.fail/]Drugs & Wires[/url] 的视觉小说衍生作品。
